tested:
FortiManager - NO entry existed here at all (only FortiGate did), so
get_profile("fortinet-FMG-7.2.2"/"fortinet-fortimanager-...") fell all the way
through to GENERIC_KVM_PROFILE (512MB RAM, 1 vCPU, e1000, 120s boot_timeout).
Live-reproduced 2026-07-18 (device audit 93dd0297-19c4-4887-8fef-da65d2d4f0a5):
booting the real virtioa.qcow2 (FMG 7.2.2) at the generic-fallback 512MB
deterministically kernel-panics every single boot attempt -
"VFS: Unable to mount root fs on unknown-block(2,0)" at ~5s uptime, looping
forever (matches the audit's "timeout"/never-RUNNING and the UI run's
Running-pill-but-never-boot-ready symptom - the QEMU *process* stays up and
libvirt reports VIR_DOMAIN_RUNNING, restart-looping the guest kernel forever,
so node-manager status flips to RUNNING immediately while the guest itself
never boots). Identical image at 8192MB (this profile's value, matching the
documented spec in docs/platform/node-emulation.md's Fortinet appliance
matrix - "FortiManager VM ... host ... 8192 MB ... 4 ... virtio-net-pci ...
virtio") boots past that point straight into the FortiOS "Serial
number:FMG-VM..." banner - same image, same disk bus, only RAM changed.
min_ram_mb enforces the floor; default_ram_mb is what a new node gets.

reasons.emulator:
cpu_model "qemu64", not "host" (NPX-1527 PROFILES-TOOLS pass-3, rule #59):
EVE-NG's real fortinet.yml (the one template all 4 FortiOS-family keys in this
file map to) sets NO -cpu flag at all, which QEMU defaults to qemu64 - "host" here
was undocumented drift with no cited crash/boot evidence (unlike the RAM values on
these same entries, which do carry real cited evidence). Matching EVE's real,
verified-safe default until/unless a live boot specifically justifies "host".
NOT live-boot-verified either way this pass - if a future boot needs "host",
cite the evidence here per rule #59 before changing it back.
reasons.min_enforcement: NPX-1918: dead "multi_disk" flag removed - real image is a single qcow2 file.
reasons.config_dialect:
FortiManager shares FortiAnalyzer's management-appliance CLI, not FortiGate's
FortiOS - same "no full-configuration keyword" gap. See fortinet-faz's own
comment above (live-measured on FAZ; FMG hit the identical capture failure
in the real Wave 21 fleet run, 2026-09-10).

settings.min_enforcement_msg: FortiManager requires minimum 4 GB RAM and 4 vCPUs (Fortinet recommends 8 GB) - too little RAM prevents the guest kernel from even mounting its own root filesystem, not just slow boot
